display.purpose: Headings (hero through subsection), stat/prize numbers, nav wordmark.

body.purpose: Body copy, nav links, buttons, form labels/inputs, table content, badges.

mono.purpose: Timestamps and technical identifiers only; never at heading size.

shadows.name: elevation
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns, popovers only — never a static card or section.

shadows.name: glow-primary
shadows.purpose: Active/live state emphasis: 1st-place Featured card border, (future) active timeline milestone and live badges.

shadows.name: glow-ember
shadows.purpose: Same active/live role as glow-primary, for ember-toned contexts.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The shared keyboard focus-visible treatment on every interactive primitive.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single interactive-action element — primary CTA, active state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary-hover)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: hsl(var(--primary-active)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border-focus)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; background: hsl(var(--surface-secondary)); color: hsl(var(--text-primary)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: hsl(var(--surface-tertiary)); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { border-color: hsl(var(--border-light)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(var(--border-focus)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.45); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Non-committal secondary action, no fill at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--text-secondary)); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsl(var(--surface-secondary)); color: hsl(var(--text-primary)); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: hsl(var(--surface-tertiary)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border-focus)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.45); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Genuinely destructive actions only — never a routine cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; background: hsl(var(--error)); color: hsl(var(--error-foreground)); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: hsl(var(--error-hover)); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { background: hsl(var(--error-active)); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border-focus)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.45); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text entry shell shared by Input/Textarea/Select.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; background: hsl(var(--surface)); color: hsl(var(--text-primary)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--text-muted)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(var(--border-focus)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.45); } .ds-input:disabled { background: hsl(var(--surface-muted)); color: hsl(var(--text-muted)); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: hsl(var(--error)); }

components.name: Default Badge
components.description: Neutral inline status/label indicator, no state implied.
components.css: .ds-badge-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; background: hsl(var(--surface-tertiary)); color: hsl(var(--text-secondary)); }

components.name: Live/Event Badge
components.description: Genuine live/urgent state — registration open, event in progress.
components.css: .ds-badge-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; background: hsl(var(--primary-muted)); color: hsl(var(--primary)); }

components.name: Standard Card
components.css: .ds-card-standard { border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background: hsl(var(--surface-secondary)); padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Sora, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: hsl(var(--text-primary)); margin: 0 0 0.375rem; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(var(--text-secondary)); margin: 0; }

components.name: Featured Card (1st place)
components.description: Reserved exclusively for the 1st-place prize card — border + glow, not a general emphasis toggle.
components.css: .ds-card-featured { border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary)); background: hsl(var(--surface-secondary)); padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 0 32px hsl(28 88% 54% / 0.35); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Sora, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: hsl(var(--text-primary)); margin: 0 0 0.375rem; } .ds-card-stat { font-family: Sora, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: hsl(var(--primary)); margin: 0; }

narrative.northStar: Ignition, ascent, warmth rising out of depth
narrative.overview: This is a dark indigo-navy platform, not a pure-black one — the navy tint is deliberate, chosen specifically to avoid reading as "generic dark-mode SaaS" while still matching the promotional poster's base tone. Against that canvas, a single saturated saffron-orange (primary) is the one accent that means "act here" — reserved for CTAs, key numbers, and active states — with a secondary ember-red (ember) reserved for "this is happening now" (live/urgent signals only, never a default color and never a badge variant of its own). The system explicitly rejects gradients as a base surface treatment: the only approved gradient anywhere in the product is a single radial ignition glow confined to the homepage hero, and even that section is not yet built. Indian national identity is carried through color temperature and typographic confidence — warmth against deep navy — not through tricolor stripes, rangoli motifs, or literal map/globe illustration; the source docs are explicit that this would read as costume rather than identity. Hierarchy throughout comes from scale, weight, and surface layering rather than decoration; functional pages (forms, tables, long-form text) are written to stay legible and calm rather than spectacular. The specified system also names two things it deliberately is not: it should not read as "a hackathon poster turned into a website," and it should not read as "a purple AI SaaS template." Restraint and warmth carry the identity, not ornamentation.
keyCharacteristics: One dark canvas (background/surface*), one accent that prompts action (primary), one accent that signals urgency (ember) — never both at full saturation in the same region.
Flat, layered surfaces and hairline 1px borders instead of shadows or gradients as the default hierarchy mechanism.
A geometric display face (Sora) for headings and stat numbers, a workhorse body face (Inter) for everything else, and a monospace face (JetBrains Mono) reserved for IDs/timestamps.
Dark-mode-only, with no light-mode variant defined anywhere in the token system — see Known Discrepancies for this decision's actual approval status.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: primary and ember are never both used as dominant, full-saturation colors in the same region of a screen — using both recreates the poster's gradient collision this system deliberately rejects.

rules.name: The Semantic Separation Rule
rules.body: success/warning/error/info are never borrowed for brand emphasis, and primary/ember are never repurposed to mean a status.

rules.name: The One Heavy Pairing Rule
rules.body: Heavy display weight (700) paired with the accent color is reserved exclusively for stat/prize numbers — no other element combines that weight and that color.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Dark UIs communicate elevation through layered surface tokens, not shadow; shadow-elevation is reserved for things that are literally floating above the page — never a static card, never a page section.

rules.name: The Glow-Means-Live Rule
rules.body: glow-primary/glow-ember are reserved for active, live, or focused states only; using either as decoration on an element at rest is a misuse of the token.

dos: Do trace every color used in a component to a token defined above — no raw hex/rgb anywhere in component code.
Do give every interactive element a visible :focus-visible state using the shared .focus-ring treatment.
Do pair every badge/status indicator with an icon and/or text label — color alone never communicates state.
Do keep public-route and any future participant/admin-route components importing from the same components/ui primitives — one component library, never a forked one.
Do use the Featured Card treatment (border + Glow Primary) exclusively for the 1st-place prize card once Prize Card exists — not as a general emphasis toggle.
donts: Don't use arbitrary Tailwind colors (e.g. bg-orange-500) or introduce a gradient outside the single approved hero ignition glow (not yet built).
Don't use glow-primary/glow-ember/shadow-elevation as decoration — glow means active/live/focused, and elevation means literally floating (modal/dropdown/popover), never a static card or section.
Don't use warning to represent an actual error, or ember to mean "error."
Don't let primary and ember both appear as dominant, full-saturation colors in the same screen region.
Don't use tricolor stripes, rangoli patterns, or literal map/globe illustration as UI chrome to express Indian identity — warmth and typographic confidence carry that, per the source docs.
Don't use continuous/looping animation or bounce/elastic easing anywhere in the product.
Don't set outline: none on any interactive element without the .focus-ring box-shadow replacement.
